svg.title: Contents limit versus a jewellery special limit versus a floater
svg.desc: A labelled 80000 dollar contents limit does not lift a 6000 dollar jewellery theft special limit. A scheduled floater insures one ring for 18000 dollars. Illustration, not a policy.
svg.text: The cap is inside the big number
Labelled sketch. Copy the real special limit from your wordings. 24 Sep 2026.
Raising contents to $80,000 does not move the $6,000 theft cap.
Unscheduled, the $18,000 ring is short $12,000 before the deductible, in this sketch.
Fire and mysterious disappearance may use different caps. Read the peril.
Education only. Not your form and not an appraisal.
